nodes.label: Arena Production Architecture v2
nodes.rationale: Every component is decided as if shipping to 10,000 concurrent users across 200 Indian colleges, 50 hiring companies, and an open professional pool; Arena is positioned as Capabilio's 'evidence layer' beside Pulse (visibility), Nexus (network), and Launchpad (opportunities).

nodes.label: challenges Table Schema
nodes.rationale: Canonical challenge catalog row: type/domain/difficulty/elo_impact/sandbox_type plus company sponsorship, recruiter visibility, and college/tag restrictions.

nodes.label: challenge_attempts Table Schema
nodes.rationale: Per-attempt lifecycle (in_progress/submitted/evaluated/failed) carrying code_snapshot, execution_result, test_results, feedback, grade, and elo_delta.

nodes.label: ELO Computation Model (computeEloUpdate)
nodes.rationale: Modified Elo formula: expected-score curve vs challenge ELO, K-factor scaled down as user ELO rises (48/36/28/20), 15%-per-retry attempt penalty, up-to-10% time-efficiency bonus, a floor of +3 ELO on any pass (score>=70), and a cap of -30 loss per submission to prevent cliff drops.

nodes.label: Streak Computation Model (computeStreak)
nodes.rationale: Active day = >=1 submission (IST); freezes (limited per month) preserve the streak across a missed day; milestones from Ignition (3d) to Century Club (100d).

nodes.label: Execution Sandbox Model (Piston/Judge0)
nodes.rationale: Piston API primary with Judge0 CE fallback for coding challenges (10s/test, 30s total, 256MB cap, no filesystem writes/network); separate execution models for SQL (isolated Postgres schema per challenge), Frontend/React (iframe sandbox + esm.sh CDN), and Notebook/Python (Pyodide).

nodes.label: Proof Model (proof_artifacts)
nodes.rationale: Every submission creates a proof_artifacts record with trust_level (verified/ai_graded/self_reported) and a public_proof_url recruiters can check at /recruiter/candidates/:uid/proof.

nodes.label: Leaderboard Snapshot Strategy
nodes.rationale: Leaderboards are deliberately NOT computed per-request: a node-cron job snapshots into leaderboard_snapshots every 30 minutes so ranks are served with O(1) lookup instead of live aggregation.

nodes.label: College Analytics Model
nodes.rationale: Per-college aggregate view: active_students_7d, elo_distribution, branch_readiness, skill_map (strong/weak), company_track_readiness, and recruiter_ready_pool.

nodes.label: Arena Permissions Model + RLS
nodes.rationale: Row-Level Security enforces challenge_attempts writable only by owner, proof_artifacts readable by recruiters only when is_recruiter_visible=true, and leaderboard_snapshots publicly readable as proof of rank.
